redFirst.basis: Task mode is regression with tests.expectRedFirst false, so no helper red was owed. The red was observed by hand instead, against a HEAD render made from a `git archive HEAD` export (no change to the shared tree). The new check-report-interactive.mjs run on HEAD's acme render exited 1: the stress case failed with 'page.pdf: Protocol error (Page.printToPDF): Printing failed' (15725 rows, 3569695 px, 8.3 s), and the per-phase section-7 cases also failed (0 parts for 7 phases). The same check on a fresh render with the fix exited 0, stress printed in 25.7 s. Mutation reds on fresh-render copies: table-layout:auto -> 'one grid' got 2; reversed join -> 'afterprint puts every row back' got 44; one segment's table-hiding selector removed -> '...and so are their tables' false. Each mutant failed only its intended case.

outcome.technical: DESIGN (b): split the phases table at print time on beforeprint and join it back on afterprint. Probes in scratchpad/mkf/bp.mjs and bp2.mjs show Playwright page.pdf fires both events, the PDF reflects the beforeprint DOM (1 -> 5 pages), and afterprint restores it. Design (a) was rejected because sorting.js (wireSort reorders tBodies[0]; blockOf/orderPhaseBlocks walk siblings across segments) and page-state.js index one table. FILES: exports.js, cutForPaper/joinAfterPaper: rows are MOVED into one table[data-paperpart] per phase, each with a cloned thead; a seghead stays with its first phase; parts carry data-seg and data-segstart; the original is marked data-papercut; afterprint re-appends the recorded rows in order and removes the parts. print-segments.css: hides the papercut original; moves the segment page break to the part (none before the first part); per-segment print hides other segments' parts; parts use table-layout:fixed with role widths (id 12%, status 11%, risk 8%, commit 17%, done 12%, tests 15%, title the rest) and overflow-wrap:anywhere in part cells. segments.css: two comments qualified (screen keeps one table, paper is cut). check-report-interactive.mjs: section 7 dispatches beforeprint, then asserts one part per phase, original hidden, every part headed, one grid (identical th left offsets across parts), and the afterprint round trip (same row nodes in the same order, no part or mark left); MediaBox/orientation kept. Per-segment print now goes through beforeprint, plus 'other segments' tables hidden' and 'joins the table back'. New stress block: a separate context grows the report's own phase blocks until the uncut print runs past 3.4M px at 688 px wide, then page.pdf(pageRanges '1') must print within 180 s. tests/test_render_report.py: pp1-pp3 construct pins. Both ui READMEs and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (render-report section) updated, the JS-off limit stated. NUMBERS (full-document page.pdf, peak renderer RSS via bug32/rss.sh): 200-phase demo: before crash 'Printing failed' after 8.9 s, peak 8212 MB; after printed 2964 pages in 65.0 s, peak 3543 MB, 201 tables at print. 600-phase demo: before crash after 9.1 s, peak 9531 MB; after printed 8894 pages in 762.9 s, peak 7946 MB, 601 tables. Live plan: before printed alone in 40.9 s (2626 pages), peak 11668 MB, and crashed inside check-report-interactive (bug32/check-real.log); after printed alone in 36.8 s (2624 pages), peak 4539 MB, 158 tables; the full check on a fresh live render printed both MediaBox PDFs (portrait 612x792, landscape 792x612), stress printed in 22.0 s. GATES: sweep exit 0 (3/3 files, 499 cases); vitest exit 0 (57 files, 854 tests); verify.sh --only report exit 1. Its fresh-render leg 'rendered-plan legs (live, one-status, all-parked, aged)' passed. Its two failing legs read the COMMITTED examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html and docs/demo-large.html, which still carry HEAD's script (grep -c cutForPaper = 0 in both): the per-phase cases fail there and the stress print crashes ('Printing failed'), i.e. the HEAD shape going red. check-rendered-artifacts.py --before-commit exits 1 with FOLLOWER-OWED for examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html (recipe examples/report.sh, which also refreshes docs/index.html) and docs/demo-large.html (recipe printed in its output). Fresh scratch renders of both passed the new check, exit 0 (acme stress 25.7 s, demo 21.8 s). I did not regenerate the followers; they are outside the task's files.
outcome.descriptive: Printing or saving a long report as PDF no longer crashes Chrome: on paper each phase becomes its own table, aligned to one grid, with every row printed. The screen still shows one table.

testsAdded: pp1 (test_render_report.py): the cut and join are wired to beforeprint/afterprint exactly once each, and the print sheet sizes the parts and hides the emptied original
pp2 (test_render_report.py): one-segment print hides other segments' part tables, counted per segment
pp3 (test_render_report.py): the segment page break sits on the part, with no break before the first part
check-report-interactive.mjs section 7: one table per phase, original off the sheet, every part headed, parts on one grid, afterprint restores every row node in order with no part left
check-report-interactive.mjs per-segment print: other segments' tables hidden, table joined back after afterprint
check-report-interactive.mjs stress: a page grown past the print length that crashed Chrome prints its first sheet within 180 s (red on HEAD's single table: Printing failed)
